title: Goubko's BFS-tree conjecture for distance spectral radius
statement: Let a tree degree sequence be fixed, and let $BFS(\mathbf{d})$ denote the breadth-first-search (greedy) tree generated by it. The **BFS-tree conjecture for distance spectral radius.** The tree $BFS(\mathbf{d})$ has the minimum distance spectral radius among all trees with degree sequence $\mathbf{d}$. This generalizes the conjecture of Stevanovic and Ilic for Volkmann trees; its status is not resolved in the source.
source_name: Mikhail Goubko, “On Minimum Terminal Distance Spectral Radius of Trees with Given Degree Sequence”, arXiv:1507.01733 (2015).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1507.01733

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of July 2015).
